newsitem.title: malaysia: Malaysia palm oil ends up after choppy session.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends up after choppy session.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,194 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,195 *
Open/hi/low 1,192/1,195/1,177 Prev close 1,190
Prev settlement 1,187 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended higher after choppy session. Late buying pushed up prices after news of smaller exports for Nov 1-15 dampened sentiment. PORLA data seen as neutral. Immediate resistance for third position remains at 1,200.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Prices closed mostly off day's highs. Trading again focused on crude palm oil with some interest also seen in palm olein.
Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for November 1-15 at 298,862 tonnes compared with 374,988 tonnes for October 1-15.
Traders said October crop figures released by the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) were discounted by the market as they were within market expectations.

PORLA put end-October palm oil stocks at 953,241 tonnes, up from 894,438 at end-September. Output in October was 883,579 tonnes, against 864,730 in September, and exports were 727,629 tonnes versus September's 649,688, PORLA said.
"The numbers were seen as neutral," one trader said.
The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan on Thursday bought 4,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil at $529.40 per tonne for shipment by December 10.
Traders said they expect prices to trade sideways next week, now that October crop data has been released.

January crude palm oil futures ended up seven ringgit at 1,194 ringgit ($473.06) a tonne after trading between 1,177 and 1,195. Traders said immediate resistance for third position contract remains at 1,200 ringgit.
Volume on the futures market was 2,308 lots against 2,116 lots on Thursday.
Physicals prices mostly closed off the day's highs. Trading again focused on crude palm oil though some interest was also seen in RBD palm olein.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,195 ringgit ($473.45) a tonne with bids at 1,187.50, after trading from 1,195 to 1,187.50.
Nov (central) was offered at 1,180 with bids at 1,172.50, and traded from 1,180 to 1,170.
Nov (north) saw offers at 1,177.50 and bids at 1,170.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,205 ringgit with bids at 1,200. It was traded from 1,205 to 1,195.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,197.50 and bids at 1,187.50, after trading from 1,197.50 to 1,190.
Among refined products, Dec palm olein was offered at $545 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/Mar also at $545. Dec was traded at $542.50 and $543.50, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $545.
Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $507.50, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $510. Jan was done at $510.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $370, Dec at $375 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $382.50.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $305.
